'''2008 World Championship''' was a Players Committee constructed World Championship, 10–12 October 2008, in Minneapolis, Minnesota. The constructed pool was [[Premiere - Original VS16]]. [[Kevin Shannon]] defeated [[Kyle Krueger]] in the final.<ref name="hof">https://www.starwarsccg.org/community/awards/</ref> Published lists are the Day 1–3 and Team PDFs on the Players Committee decklist desk.<ref name="tdl">https://www.starwarsccg.org/2008-decklists/</ref> Dates on the sheets are 10 October 2008 (Day 1), 11 October 2008 (Day 2), and 12 October 2008 (Day 3).


== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Premiere - Original VS16]]
* '''Site:''' Minneapolis, Minnesota
* '''Dates:''' 10–12 October 2008
* '''Winner:''' [[Kevin Shannon]]
